dct_title_s: General plan for the improvement of Glenwood Park, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan for the improvement of Glenwood Park in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-first Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 94.
